sources.title: Tanzil Quran Metadata / Revelation Order
sources.notes: Provides surah metadata, revelation order, ruku/juz/hizb/manzil/page/sajda structures. Revelation order is for the first revealed ayahs of a surah, not necessarily the whole surah.

sources.title: Quranic Arabic Corpus
sources.notes: Morphological, syntactic and ontology annotations. Use for semantic/language support, not as a revelation chronology authority.

sources.title: Evaluating the Effect of Occasions of Revelation (Asbab al-Nuzul)
sources.notes: Research corpus reported as 312 dataset rows and 1,101 occasions for 644 verses. The study states its narrations were taken from selected sources without independently re-grading all reports; therefore it must remain a research layer, not divine text.

sources.title: Asbab al-Nuzul by al-Wahidi
sources.notes: Classical collection of reported revelation contexts. Individual reports require provenance and may differ in strength.

sources.title: Quran Metadata Ruku Resource
sources.notes: Ruku sections are thematic/structural groupings and can be used as passage candidates; they are not claimed to be identical to revelation episodes.
